sync.title: Sync across devices
sync.intro: Use FieldShift on your phone and your computer with the same fields, plans and irrigation logs. No account needed: a private code links your devices.
sync.qrA11y: QR code to link another device to this farm
sync.codeHint: On your other device open Settings → Sync and enter this code, or scan the QR code.
sync.joinLabel: Already use FieldShift elsewhere? Enter the farm code:
sync.privacy: Your fields are stored on the FieldShift server under a random code. Anyone with the code can see and edit this farm — keep it private.
sync.statusOff: Sync off — data stays on this device
sync.statusOffline: Offline — will sync when back online
sync.statusError: Sync error — tap Sync now to retry
sync.invalidCode: This link does not contain a valid farm code.

sat.noOutline: Tip: draw your field outline (Edit field) for exact field statistics. Without it, a small square around your pin is analysed.
sat.processing: Reading Sentinel-2 images of your field…
sat.processingHint: Looking for clear 10 m satellite images from the last 12 months. This can take a minute the first time.
sat.showingCached: Showing your last saved analysis ({{date}}) while it updates.
sat.offlineCached: Offline — showing your last saved analysis ({{date}}).
sat.mapA11y: Satellite map of your field showing {{layer}}
sat.zonesIntro: An unsupervised machine-learning model (k-means) grouped your field into zones that behaved alike across all clear images this year, combined with terrain.
sat.seriesHint: Dots: field average of each clear 10 m Sentinel-2 image. Line: smoothed curve. Shaded: bare-soil periods.
sat.kcbHint: How much water your crop is using compared with a reference grass, estimated from its current greenness. FieldShift uses it to correct the water balance with what the satellite actually sees.
sat.chartA11y: Greenness chart from {{n}} satellite images. Peak NDVI {{peak}}. Season: {{type}}.
